answer: Require each agent to stake tokens and build a verifiable work history before earning full trust: a new identity starts hollow, with no reputation and tiny job limits, like a small jetty that can only berth one boat at a time. Only after completing paid, checkable tasks over time does it gain access to the main wharf of high-value work. Spinning up thousands of fake identities then costs real stake and weeks of real work per identity, while one honest agent pays that cost once.
